== Expansion (Oct 2026) ==
=== Missing data ===
* No celebrity guests are named on the 2002 home, location, or Daily News pages (unlike [[DecipherCon 2000]]).
* No published winners for the Players Committee Star Wars side events on the 23 October schedule.
* No full Day 2 Swiss standings for Star Wars CCG Worlds.
* TheForce.net 20 September 2002 qualifier list was not dested as person stubs (68 names).
* DeckTech tournament reports for this weekend were not found on stephenskilton.com.
* Gallery JPEGs MS09inside, ms66, and ms67 404 on Wayback (ms66/ms67 captions: Star Trek final on the hall screen; John Corbett and Franklin Kenter with Evan Lorentz judging).
* No contemporaneous interior photograph of the Conference Center besides the main hall.

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Convention dates: Decipher home and PC schedule are 31 October–3 November 2002. Older wiki lead used 1–3 November. LOTR-TCG Wiki dates LOTR Worlds 31 October–2 November (the LOTR final was Saturday night).
* Address: Decipher location page gives 900 Greenbrier Circle, Chesapeake, Virginia 23320. The modern Chesapeake Conference Center site uses 700 Conference Center Drive.
* Young Jedi champion: awards ceremony "Jason Kilby"; Players Committee results table "Jason Killby". Article uses Killby from the results table.
* LOTR runner-up: Daily News prose Alex Tennet (UK); results list "Alex Tennant". Article uses Tennet (SWCCG player page).
* LOTR champion given name: Daily News Mathieu; some TORN copy Matthieu. Article uses Mathieu from Daily News.
* Art Wright identification is the Decipher caption on ms52 ("Art Wright is Fierce all over"). File already dested.

=== Marginal cuts ===
* ms72 (same LOTR final on the hall projector as ms71).
* ms58 children's LOTR table; ms64 design team watching play; jewelry and convention-store product shots; leftover DecipherCon 2000 IDs in the 2002 photo tree.
* Halloween costume winners without SWCCG pages (Heidi Farinholt, Niki Rowland, Adelle Edwards, Matt Kirk).
* Hall of Fame names without SWCCG pages (product champions and retailers).
* Austin Powers CCG beyond the champion's name.

=== Build notes ===
* Hall JPEG: Wayback 20050209115156 of MS11mainhall.jpg. Venue JPEG: 20020725043320 confcenter.jpg. Banner: 20020921203959 deciphercon2002banner.jpg.
* Commons venue photograph is 2004 (RailbirdJAM, public domain), not a 2002 interior.
* Worlds Day 1 format follows the 23 October PC schedule (two 2:00 PM heats, six Swiss, top 20%), not the August worldsformats planning copy (Friday morning, four rounds / eight games).
